# ACE Agency

> Performance marketing agency from Bucharest specializing in Google Ads,
> Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and SEO for Romanian e-commerce and B2B brands.
> Founded 2020. Operated by INNOSERV SRL (CUI 47715516).

ACE Agency manages paid advertising and SEO with weekly senior reporting,
contractual ROAS targets, and 90-day minimum engagements. Documented
results include 13.34× Google Ads ROAS for ITMAR (2.38M RON revenue over
16 months), 8.11× Meta Ads ROAS for Amora (+544% revenue, 3 months), and
–87% cost-per-lead for doSense.

## Key facts

- **Brand:** ACE Agency (also: ACE Ads)
- **Legal entity:** INNOSERV SRL · CUI 47715516
- **Location:** Bucharest, Romania
- **Founded:** 2020
- **Industries served:** e-commerce (beauty, home, IT, fashion), wellness, HoReCa, professional education
- **Total revenue attributed to clients:** 5.4M+ RON
- **Active clients:** 7+ across 6 industries
- **Contract minimum:** 90 days with contractual KPI target
- **Capacity:** 3 new clients per month

## Services

- [Google Ads](https://aceads.co/servicii/google-ads): Search, Shopping, Performance Max with Smart Bidding on real conversion data
- [Meta Ads](https://aceads.co/servicii/facebook-ads): Facebook + Instagram with iterative creative cycles and server-side tracking
- [TikTok Ads](https://aceads.co/servicii/tiktok-ads): Spark Ads + UGC for DTC and under-35 audiences
- [Lead Generation](https://aceads.co/servicii): Meta Instant Forms with qualifying questions
- [SEO & Content](https://aceads.co/servicii/seo): Technical, editorial, link building, AEO and local SEO
- [Consultancy](https://aceads.co/servicii/consultanta-marketing): Audit, paid strategy, in-house implementation in 48h

## Case studies (real results, verifiable in GA4 + ad platforms)

- [Amora](https://aceads.co/studii-de-caz/amora) — Beauty e-commerce. Meta Ads from 3.04× to 8.11× ROAS in 3 months, +544% revenue.
- [ITMAR](https://aceads.co/studii-de-caz/itmar) — IT refurbished. Google + Meta + TikTok, 13.34× ROAS, +276% revenue over 16 months.
- [Trady](https://aceads.co/studii-de-caz/trady) — Home goods. 6.05× Meta ROAS, –60% CPA, –45% Google budget with +67% ROAS.
- [doSense](https://aceads.co/studii-de-caz/dosense) — Wellness services. Meta Lead Gen from 15 bookings to 304 leads, CPL down 394 RON to 52 RON.
